newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Italgas cut at CSFB. [CORRECTED 16:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Italgas cut at CSFB. [CORRECTED 16:25 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects bank's name in headline from Goldman to CSFB)
Earnings estimates for Italian natural gas distributor Italgas were cut at CS First Boston, the investment bank said on Thursday.
For 1997, CSFB cut its earnings estimate by 35 percent to 81 billion lire, mainly because of a particularly warm first quarter in which it said sales could be down by as much as 10 percent.

CSFB said the 1995 dividend level could be at risk for 1996 and said it expected a 37 percent decline in 1996 net earnings to 63 billion lire, following a higher-than-expected extraordinary loss and voluntary retirements by staff.
CSFB repeated a "hold" rating on the stock.
